title: THIS Is How Hamsters Fit So Much Food Inside Their Cheeks! | Pets: Wild At Heart | BBC Earth

segments.description: Wide establishing shot of a pet golden hamster emerging from its burrow in a simulated desert environment [[00:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=7)].
Medium tracking shot of the hamster scurrying rapidly through transparent experimental tunnels [[00:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=23)].
Medium close-up x-ray view revealing the hamster's highly flexible spine bending completely around sharp turns in the tunnel [[00:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=47)].
Medium action shot of the hamster eagerly grabbing food from a bowl and stuffing its cheeks with surplus treats [[01:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=98)].
Close-up x-ray animation showing the hamster's cheek pouches extending all the way back to its hips to store food dry [[02:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=136)].
Medium close-up action shot of the hamster using its dexterous paws to disgorge stored nuts from its dry cheek pouches [[03:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=212)].
Wide cinematic shot of a desert canyon at sunset, concluding the wildlife documentary segment [[04:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWzuNr0ulUY&t=252)].
